verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews explicitly promise to 'coordinate preventative follow-up actions' as part of incident learning (docs-36, docs-38), and PagerDuty offers 750+ integrations plus a REST API/webhooks that could sync data to external tools (docs-50, docs-32, docs-39). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated issue-tracker (e.g., Jira) sync for follow-up action items or of tracking those actions to completion/closure. Missing for 10: explicit issue-tracker (Jira/Asana) integration for follow-up items, a documented completion-tracking workflow for action items, and independent/hands-on confirmation that follow-ups are actually synced and closed out.
